svg.title: Agents draft, people decide
svg.desc: Swimlane of Delegate: the nightly Databricks job runs four agents, the runtime pulls the facts, a writer agent in Azure AI Foundry drafts the page from those facts only, the verifier checks every number, and the page waits until an account manager approves, which logs the activity in Dynamics 365 and opens an Outlook draft.
svg.text: Nothing is logged or sent until a person approves.
